steps.title: Join
steps.action: FULL OUTER JOIN file wd.dvwsd and file sap.it41 on column "Workday ID & Position".
steps.notes: A FULL OUTER JOIN keeps every record from file 1 (wd.dvwsd) and every record from file 2 (sap.it41). Matching records are combined when the keys ("Workday ID & Position" / "Workday ID & Position") match. As a result, rows from either file may contain NULL values for the other file columns if no match is found.

steps.title: Join
steps.action: LEFT JOIN file wd.dvwsd and file sap.hi0256 on column "Workday ID & Position".
steps.notes: A LEFT JOIN keeps every record from file 1 (wd.dvwsd) and adds matching details from file 2 (sap.hi0256) when a match is found. Rows in file 2 (sap.hi0256) will not be kept if the keys ("Workday ID & Position" / "Workday ID & Position") do not match. As a result, rows from file 1 (wd.dvwsd) may contain NULL values if no match is found in file 2 (sap.hi0256).

steps.title: Join
steps.action: LEFT JOIN file sap.hi0256 and file s9.cont on file sap.hi0256 column "persno" and file s9.cont column "S9 ID".
steps.notes: A LEFT JOIN keeps every record from file 1 (sap.hi0256) and adds matching details from file 2 (s9.cont) when a match is found. Rows in file 2 (s9.cont) will not be kept if the keys ("persno" / "S9 ID") do not match. As a result, rows from file 1 (sap.hi0256) may contain NULL values if no match is found in file 2 (s9.cont).
